display.title: {"text": "Roadside Ruins & Camps"}
description: Small, quick discoveries between destinations: ruins, shrines, camps, guide posts, watchtowers. Five minutes each.
&ePrepare:&r Stone tools, food. Occasionally a few hostile mobs.
&eSignature rewards:&r Wayfarer Shards, occasional charts to temples and arcane sites.
&eComing back:&r Found everywhere; the main shard income while travelling.
&eFeeds into:&r Shards -> warp stones, gem dust, backpack upgrades.
&aObjective:&r Step inside any structure of this family.
&bWhy it matters:&r Knowing what a family offers before you go makes the trip worth it.
